<?php
$target = new Fiber(static function () {
    echo Fiber::suspend('Y'), '|';
    return 17;
});
$weak = WeakReference::create($target);
echo $target->start(), '|';
$other = new Fiber(static function () { echo 'UNREACHED|'; return 99; });
$pair = [$target, 'ReSuMe'];
$runner = new Fiber($pair);
$pair[0] = $other;
$pair[1] = 'throw';
unset($target, $pair);
echo (int)($weak->get() !== null), '|';
echo (int)($runner->start(value: 'R') === null), '|';
echo (int)($weak->get() === null), '|', (int)$runner->isTerminated(), '|';
echo (int)($runner->getReturn() === null), '|', (int)$other->isStarted();
engine_derived_expectation: Constructor callback selection keeps the original plain-array snapshot through external COW writes and selector retirement. RAW owns its array and bound member; after the callback finishes, its last target owner retires. All getReturn reads follow normal termination.

$receiver = $target;
$method = 'ReSuMe';
$pair = [&$receiver, &$method];
$runner = new Fiber($pair);
$receiver = $other;
$method = 'throw';
$pair = null;
echo (int)($runner->start(value: 'R') === null), '|';
echo $target->getReturn(), '|', (int)$other->isStarted(), '|';
echo (int)($runner->getReturn() === null);
engine_derived_expectation: Constructor fci_cache freezes the selected method and receiver before member-reference mutation. The original selected target deliberately remains owned by its main variable: the engine cache itself is borrowed, while RAW now owns the changed receiver reference. No dangling cached receiver is invoked.

function rawArrayStartBody(int $value, $suffix = 'D', ...$tail) {
    global $target;
    echo $value, '|', $suffix, '|', $tail['tag'], '|';
    echo (int)(Fiber::getCurrent() === $target), '|';
    echo Fiber::suspend('Y'), '|';
    return 29;
}
$target = new Fiber('rawArrayStartBody');
$runner = new Fiber([$target, 'StArT']);
$parent = new Fiber(static function () use ($runner) {
    echo 'P|';
    echo (int)($runner->start(value: '7', tag: 'X') === null), '|';
    return 19;
});
$parent->start();
echo $runner->getReturn(), '|', (int)$runner->isTerminated(), '|';
echo (int)($target->resume('R') === null), '|';
echo $target->getReturn(), '|', $parent->getReturn();
engine_derived_expectation: Original named/default/variadic forwarding crosses a real main-parent-runner-target chain. The root START callback returns its target suspension value into the runner return store; the outer start returns null. All return reads follow defined completion.

<?php
class RawArrayCtorBase {
    public static function callback() { echo 'UNREACHED|'; return 11; }
}
class RawArrayCtorChild extends RawArrayCtorBase {}
$target = new Fiber(static function () { echo 'UNREACHED|'; return 17; });
$weak = WeakReference::create($target);
$pair = [$target, '__construct'];
$runner = new Fiber($pair);
unset($target, $pair);
set_error_handler(static function ($level, $message) {
    echo 'W', (int)($level === 8192), (int)(Fiber::getCurrent() === $GLOBALS['runner']), '|';
    echo 'R', Fiber::suspend('P'), '|';
    return true;
});
echo $runner->start(callback: [RawArrayCtorChild::class, 'RawArrayCtorBase::callback']), '|';
try { $runner->resume(9); }
catch (FiberError $error) {
    echo $error->getMessage(), '|';
    foreach ($error->getTrace() as $frame) {
        echo $frame['function'], '.', (int)isset($frame['file']), (int)isset($frame['line']), '|';
    }
}
unset($error);
restore_error_handler();
echo (int)$runner->isTerminated(), '|', (int)($weak->get() === null);
engine_derived_expectation: The RAW array retains the last constructor receiver through deprecated compound callback parsing and a suspended warning handler. Resuming authentic parser continuation rejects repeated construction, with real root/API traces; neither callback body executes and no failed return is read.

<?php
function rawArrayThrowBody() {
    global $original;
    try { Fiber::suspend('Y'); }
    catch (Exception $caught) {
        echo (int)($caught === $original), '|', $caught->getMessage(), '|';
        return 37;
    }
}
$target = new Fiber('rawArrayThrowBody');
echo $target->start(), '|';
$original = new Exception('X');
$runner = new Fiber([$target, 'ThRoW']);
echo (int)($runner->start(exception: $original) === null), '|';
echo (int)($runner->getReturn() === null), '|';
$get = new Fiber([$target, 'GeTrEtUrN']);
echo (int)($get->start() === null), '|', $get->getReturn(), '|';
$status = new Fiber([$target, 'IsTeRmInAtEd']);
echo (int)($status->start() === null), '|', (int)$status->getReturn();
engine_derived_expectation: The raw bound throw callback injects the original Throwable into the actual suspended target. Later raw getReturn and status callbacks consume only the safely defined return37 and terminated state.
